budget_9_plus_54_plus_9_equals_72_and_ma.evidence: Module constants, amendment, journal reservation order, seal, and focused tests agree on 9 anchor + 54 inner segment + 9 outer segment fits and 21 materializations. No numerical orchestration consumes the ledger.

original_round_b_family_features_weights.evidence: Pinned family is event_day_balanced_binary_lgbm, original seeds are 20260813/20260829/20260847, parameters and event/day weights are implemented, and held outer parsing uses event_day_balanced_binary_lgbm__probability/prediction rather than a legacy XGB column. The worker does not construct or apply the inner anchors.

chronology_leakage_and_firewall.evidence: No executable training/evaluation route proves chronological isolation. The source of leakage-safe anchor probabilities for segment-model training rows is undefined; current global segment robust normalization/CUSUM is not bounded by the declared context bank.

transitive_seal_authorization_qa_and_cra.evidence: The future authorization checker does not require or verify the preexecution seal, strict-preflight receipt, independent-QA report, QA verdict, or exact equality of authorization-controlled scientific/input maps with the sealed template. There is no success publisher or completed journal transition.

official_path_firewall.evidence: No official test/sample/submission/candidate path was read by this audit; actual authorization, execution.lock, attempt_journal, result.json, manifest.json, and 999_completed.json are absent.

actual_72_fit_numerical_orchestration_is.evidence: execute_worker always raises AuthorizationError after static/data preflight. It never claims AttemptJournal, imports/calls the numerical primitives, fits any model, computes bootstrap/gates, or publishes aggregate outputs.

findings.title: The sealed worker is an unconditional zero-fit stop, not an executable Cycle-1 package
evidence: scripts/run_p1_long_event_segment_proposal_rescore_v1.py:1195-1204 calls authorization/static/data checks and then unconditionally raises AuthorizationError.
There is no numerical orchestration function, no AttemptJournal.begin call on the worker path, and no result/manifest/report/completed-journal publisher.

tests/test_run_p1_long_event_segment_proposal_rescore_v1.py:413-431 explicitly expects execution rejection and a placeholder authorization; all 18 tests can pass while the worker remains non-executable.
findings.impact: Embedding a valid authorization digest cannot produce the preregistered 72 fits or any scientific decision. Current-v1 execution would only fail after expensive readiness reads.
findings.required_fix: Create a new sealed successor revision with a complete execute_worker orchestration. Keep the frozen design/trigger/amendment hashes as authorities; do not mutate the current sealed files.

findings.title: Authorization is not transitively bound to the seal, preflight, or independent QA proof
evidence: scripts/run_p1_long_event_segment_proposal_rescore_v1.py:853-879 verifies status, experiment id, normalized runner, and maps supplied by the authorization itself.
It does not require the preexecution-seal hash, strict-preflight hash, independent-QA report hash/verdict, or exact equality between authorization scientific/input maps and the sealed template.
An authorization can therefore replace its own dependency/input/outer-surface maps and still be checked against those replacement values.
findings.impact: A nominal AUTHORIZED_INDEPENDENT_QA_PASS file is not cryptographic evidence that the independently audited package and inputs are the ones executed.
findings.required_fix: Make the successor authorization pin the predecessor seal, preflight receipt, this QA JSON/MD pair, PASS successor-QA verdict, normalized runner, module/tests, and one canonical immutable template. Validate byte-for-byte equality of all scientific, budget, input, and outer-surface maps against that canonical sealed template before any import or claim.

findings.title: Declared receipt chronology is impossible
evidence: The seal that claims to have read that template declares created_at_kst=2026-08-26T07:52:22.590435+09:00.
The strict preflight declares created_at_kst=2026-08-26T07:52:30.843172+09:00; both receipts precede the template they attest.
findings.impact: The current chronology claim cannot support a trustworthy pre-execution chain even though hashes match.
findings.required_fix: Issue a new correctly timestamped template and only then create a new seal and strict preflight. Add monotonic declared-time checks and include filesystem-independent predecessor receipt hashes.

findings.title: Leakage-safe segment-model training surface is unspecified
evidence: The nine prospective Round-B fits define one three-seed prefix model per inner window and honest validation prediction, but neither code nor amendment states how anchor probabilities for labeled segment-model training proposals are obtained without in-sample stacking.
The 54 inner segment fits and nine outer segment fits have no implemented training-row constructor, prefix/validation masks, encoder-fit boundary, or exact source of anchor surfaces.
findings.impact: A naive implementation would train the meta-model on anchor probabilities produced by models fitted on the same labels, causing meta-feature target leakage and a train/validation calibration shift.
findings.required_fix: Before any fit, freeze and test the exact row-level segment-training protocol. Every segment-training anchor probability must be from a model that did not fit that row's label, or the experiment must stop/re-register with the extra cross-fit budget. Do not silently exceed 72 fits.

findings.title: Peer residual is computed across stations instead of across simultaneous layers within a station
evidence: src/p1_qc/long_event_segment_proposal_rescore.py:421-430 groups by (time, layer) and subtracts values from other stations.
The canonical P1 feature implementation at src/p1_qc/features.py:274-283 defines peers as simultaneous same-station layers and naturally yields no peer for G-ORS.
findings.impact: The implemented feature is geographically cross-station and does not implement the stated I/S dynamic cross-layer peer channel; it can inject unrelated ocean-regime differences.
findings.required_fix: Group by (station, time), exclude the target layer/row, retain I/S only and the G univariate fallback, then add a synthetic axis test proving cross-station values cannot affect a row.

findings.title: Proposal normalization and two-sided CUSUM have unbounded full-segment dependency
evidence: src/p1_qc/long_event_segment_proposal_rescore.py:357-397 estimates robust center/scale and prefix/suffix CUSUM over each entire contiguous segment.
The preregistered structures are explicitly 24/72/168-hour context banks and the outer purge is seven days.
findings.impact: If a full station-layer segment is supplied, a row can depend on values arbitrarily far beyond the declared bank/purge; if partitions are supplied separately, boundary behavior and feature definitions change. No worker currently resolves this.
findings.required_fix: Use fixed bank-bounded leave-center-out statistics/CUSUM within exact segments, or register a finite maximum dependency and matching purge before fit. Add a far-future perturbation test beyond the declared dependency.

findings.title: Segment-classifier hyperparameters are absent from the prospective design/amendment authority
evidence: SEGMENT_MODEL_PARAMETERS (400 trees, learning rate 0.03, 31 leaves, and related values) appear only in src/p1_qc/long_event_segment_proposal_rescore.py:93-108 and its post-hoc implementation contract.
The design and operational amendment enumerate Round-B anchor parameters but not the segment-model parameters or a pinned pre-existing lineage for them.
findings.impact: The package cannot substantiate the design claim that every numeric choice was immutable at original preregistration time.
findings.required_fix: In a prospective successor amendment created before Cycle-1 numerical results, enumerate the already-coded segment parameters and their non-result-based lineage; do not tune or change them after any inner result.

required_successor_acceptance_tests: A temp-directory integration test with fake fit/predict callables reaches exactly 72 reserve/complete pairs and at most 21 materialization reservations, with exact phase/window/cell/seed order.
The same test proves three anchor fits are shared across six cells per inner window and that held outer labels are not reachable until the selected cell is immutable.

Exact Round-B 80-feature ordering, per-prefix TabularEncoder fit, event/day weights, three original seeds, probability mean, plateau/singleton detectors, and 0.2/0.1/0/12 postprocess are asserted on every inner anchor.
The segment-training anchor surface is demonstrably out-of-sample for every labeled proposal row; otherwise fail before claim or register a new budget/design.

Pooled inner threshold selection, deterministic cell selection, outer one-shot scoring, 5000-replicate event/day paired bootstrap, every research/submission gate, and seed/fold/station/slice metrics are implemented and tested.

Success publication is create-only and durable on Windows: aggregate result/report/manifest are flushed while lock exists, 999_completed is last journal entry, lock unlink is the final commit, directory is flushed, and no post-release operation occurs.
Injected failures at initialization, each fit, metric/bootstrap, and publication retain the lock and write one sanitized terminal failure; no automatic resume/rerun is possible.

Authorization tamper tests reject changed seal, preflight, QA report, dependency, scientific map, input map, outer surface, runtime, runner, module, tests, or user-approval proof before numerical import and claim.
Path-firewall tests prove zero reads of official test/sample/submission/candidate/P3 paths and zero candidate generation.

test_evidence.interpretation: Static primitives and the fail-closed zero-fit state are internally consistent; this does not establish executability.

terminal_statement: The frozen scientific design and Round-B trigger selection are preserved, but the current sealed package is not an executable experiment. It must not be authorized. A new independently audited successor revision is required; no current-v1 fit budget has been consumed.
